# Hebrew School of the Arts

> A Sunday Hebrew school at the Chabad Jewish Center of Troy, Michigan, built around
> an art studio and a kosher kitchen. Ages 4 to 13. Culinary. Creative. Jewish.
> Make. Bake. Belong.

Every fact below is confirmed by the school. Where something is not yet decided it says
so rather than guessing.

## The essentials

- **What it is:** a Sunday Hebrew school, art-forward, with cooking as a secondary strand
- **Who runs it:** Chabad Jewish Center of Troy. Hebrew School Director: Mrs. Chana Caytak
- **Where:** 4050 Coolidge Hwy, Troy, MI 48098
- **Phone:** 248-873-5851
- **Who it serves:** families from across the Metro Detroit area, affiliated and unaffiliated
- **Ages:** 4 to 13
- **When:** Sundays, 10:00 AM to 12:00 PM
- **First day:** Sunday, October 11, 2026
- **Length of year:** 23 sessions. The full schedule, including breaks, is not yet published
- **Tuition:** $950 per child for the year, plus a $100 registration fee per child
- **New families:** first year of tuition is free; the $100 registration fee still applies
- **Financial assistance:** available, confidential, and requires no proof of income or
  financial statements. The registration fee is not covered by it.

## The three divisions

- **Sprouts**, ages 4-5 — songs, snacks, mess and repetition
- **Roots**, ages 6-8 — Hebrew reading starts to click, kitchen and studio
- **The Mitzvah Crew & Bat Mitzvah Club**, ages 9-13 — real responsibility in the kitchen,
  deeper learning, and Bar and Bat Mitzvah preparation

## What a Sunday looks like

Two hours, 10:00 to 12:00: arrival, Hebrew in small groups by reading level rather than by
age, the hands-on block, Torah and story, then tasting what they made and pickup.

The hands-on block is usually the art studio. Every group takes a turn in the kitchen about
once a month.

## Hebrew reading

Taught with **Aleph Champ**, a ten-level colour-coded programme (white, red, orange, yellow,
green, blue, purple, brown, grey, black) with three stripes inside each level. Children are
grouped by reading level, not age. Most students arrive knowing no Hebrew at all.

## The art studio

A dedicated art teacher comes every week. The room is led by **Ryan Merritt**, a painter
based in Troy, trained at the Savannah College of Art and Design, who paints landscapes and
geometric abstracts in oil and acrylic and teaches art history.
